title: veronica longifolia subsp. exortiva
intro: Veronica longifolia subsp. exortiva, commonly known as the alpine speedwell, is a subspecies of flowering plant that belongs to the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). The alpine speedwell is known for its health benefits, particularly in reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant, which may help to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of the alpine speedwell include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can be beneficial in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the alpine speedwell include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
